Sara / Maya — quick follow-up from the GTM side.

We can support a more aggressive frontload for the first 60 days to help Cloudline hit POC milestones. Practical notes:
- We typically model an "activation tranche" (30–40% of committed credits) that is redeemable within the first 90 days; the rest redeems over the remainder of the year.
- On GCP side, partner sales are open to amending the private offer to reflect the tranche timing — they asked for a short LOI that mirrors the drawdown and confirms billing entity.

I uploaded the LOI the partner wanted (signed_loi.pdf) to the HubSpot deal. If Cloudline OKs the activation tranche, we should prepare a short DocuSign amendment to the existing private offer so GCP will honor the frontload. Link to HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1245-CLD-RDW-332

Maya — recommend we propose: 40% activation tranche (redeemable days 0–60), 60% phased monthly thereafter. Laura, if we go this route is splitting invoices acceptable (activation fee invoice + monthly consumption)?

Hi all — from finance: we can accommodate the activation tranche and split invoicing, but need the following to proceed cleanly:

Required for invoice onboarding:
- Billing legal entity name, address, and VAT/Tax ID (if applicable)
- PO number to appear on invoices (Cloudline should provide)
- Bank wiring instructions or payment terms (Net30 preferred)

Recommended invoicing flow:
1) One-time activation invoice (covers the activation tranche) issued upon DocuSign of the amendment
2) Monthly consumption invoices tied to actual SKU usage against the remaining commitment (we can issue these monthly to align with GCP billing windows)

I'll attach a sample invoice template to illustrate required fields. Please confirm Cloudline can provide the legal/billing details and a PO number. Also, if Cloudline needs split invoices routed to multiple cost centers, include routing instructions on the PO.
